# bluestonepim_attribute_group_order (Resource)

The order of the attribute groups. The listed groups are placed first, in the given order; groups that are not listed keep their relative order after them. Removing the resource leaves the order as it is. Use only one of these resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bluestonepim_attribute_group" "general" {
  name = "General"
}

resource "bluestonepim_attribute_group" "dimensions" {
  name = "Dimensions"
}

# Groups not listed here are shown after these
resource "bluestonepim_attribute_group_order" "this" {
  group_ids = [
    bluestonepim_attribute_group.general.id,
    bluestonepim_attribute_group.dimensions.id,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_ids` (List of String) The IDs of the attribute groups, in the order they should be shown.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `attribute_group_order`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bluestonepim_attribute_group_order.this attribute_group_order
```
